coupling_convention: dimensionless coupling strength ε (dark photon/baryon coupling parameter)
notes: Paper presents first search for dark photon dark matter using LISA Pathfinder data (3 months, frequency range 2×10⁻⁵–5 Hz, corresponding to masses 8×10⁻²⁰–2×10⁻¹⁴ eV). No signal detected; upper limits set on dark photon/baryon coupling strength ε. Figure 5 shows exclusion limits in both semi-coherent and fully-coherent regimes. The coupling parameter ε is defined in Eq. 2 as the strength of dark photon coupling to baryon/baryon-lepton number current, normalized by electromagnetic coupling constant. Limits are mass-independent (flat) across the analyzed frequency range, so encoded as horizontal line. Stochastic amplitude correction factor of 9 applied to ε² limits due to Tobs << Tcoh regime. DM density of 0.3 GeV/cm³ (standard galactic halo value) is implicit in the signal model (Eq. 4). Extraction confidence reduced to 0.65 because: (1) exact numerical values from Figure 5 are approximate (read from plot), (2) paper constrains dark photon coupling to baryons but does not provide explicit tabulated coupling values, (3) the coupling convention ε is somewhat non-standard (normalized by e), requiring careful interpretation. The limits are conservative compared to torsion-balance experiments but represent proof-of-concept for LISA dark matter searches. | selector: figure (sole candidate)
